name: T3MA(MTC)
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the T3MA-ALARM custom indicator, which detects direction changes of a double-smoothed moving average. It opens buy positions when the smoothed MA turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with optional reverse-close logic. Positions are managed with configurable stop loss and take profit in points.
summary_zh: 该EA基于T3MA-ALARM自定义指标的交易信号运行，该指标通过双重平滑移动平均线检测方向变化。当平滑MA向上转向时开多仓，向下转向时开空仓，并支持反向信号平仓功能。仓位通过可配置的点数止损和止盈进行管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双重平滑移动平均线（MA的MA）的方向变化来捕捉趋势转折点。入场条件为：当BufDir从-1变为1时产生买入信号（BufBuy不为零），当BufDir从1变为-1时产生卖出信号（BufSell不为零），指标缓冲区1和2分别对应买入和卖出箭头信号。出场条件有两种方式：一是通过可配置的止损和止盈点数平仓，二是通过RevClose参数启用反向信号平仓——即出现卖出信号时平掉多仓，出现买入信号时平掉空仓。仓位管理方面，仅使用固定手数（Lots参数），SolveLots函数直接返回输入的手数值，没有任何动态仓位调整或资金管理逻辑。资金管理基本缺失，没有基于账户余额或风险比例的动态手数计算，也没有追踪止损或部分平仓机制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合趋势明显的市场，但在震荡市中可能频繁止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on detecting direction changes of a double-smoothed moving average (MA of MA) to capture trend reversal points. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when BufDir changes from -1 to 1 (BufBuy buffer non-zero), and a sell signal when BufDir changes from 1 to -1 (BufSell buffer non-zero), using indicator buffers 1 and 2 respectively. Exit conditions operate in two ways: first through configurable stop loss and take profit in points, and second through the RevClose parameter which enables reverse-signal closing — closing long positions on sell signals and short positions on buy signals. Position sizing uses only a fixed lot size (Lots parameter), with the SolveLots function directly returning the input value without any dynamic sizing or money management logic. Money management is essentially absent — there is no dynamic lot calculation based on account balance or risk percentage, nor any trailing stop or partial close mechanism. The overall strategy is simple and direct, suitable for trending markets, but may suffer frequent stop-outs in choppy or ranging conditions.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: 检查指标的K线位置：0为正在形成的K线，1为最近一根已形成的K线
parameters.description_en: Bar index for indicator check: 0=current, 1=last closed

parameters.name: RevClose
parameters.description: 是否通过反向信号平仓

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于双重平滑MA方向变化捕捉趋势转折，易于理解和维护
支持反向信号平仓（RevClose），可以在趋势反转时及时退出，减少回撤
包含止损止盈的最小距离校验（CheckBuySL/TP等），避免因止损过近被拒绝
使用Shift参数控制信号K线选择，减少假信号和重复交易
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic based on double-smoothed MA direction changes to capture trend reversals, easy to understand and maintain
Supports reverse-signal closing (RevClose), allowing timely exits on trend reversals to reduce drawdown
Includes minimum stop level validation (CheckBuySL/TP etc.) to prevent order rejection due to stops too close
Shift parameter controls which bar signals are read from, reducing false signals and duplicate trades
cons: 没有动态仓位管理，固定手数无法根据账户风险自适应调整，可能导致过度或不足的风险敞口
默认止损为0，如果用户不修改参数则交易无止损保护，存在极大的资金风险
缺乏市场状态过滤机制（如波动率过滤、趋势强度过滤），在震荡市中会产生大量虚假信号导致连续亏损
SolveLots函数实际上只是返回固定手数，DeleteGV函数从未被调用，存在冗余代码
没有展开/点差过滤，在高点差环境下信号可能失效但仍会入场
cons_en: No dynamic position sizing — fixed lots cannot adapt to account risk, potentially leading to over- or under-exposure
Default StopLoss is 0, meaning trades have no stop loss protection if the user doesn't modify parameters, creating extreme capital risk
Lacks market regime filtering (volatility filter, trend strength filter), generating many false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
SolveLots function merely returns fixed lots, DeleteGV function is never called, indicating dead code
No spread filter — signals may be invalid in high-spread conditions but trades still execute
improvements: 增加基于账户余额和风险比例的动态仓位计算，替代固定手数，实现合理的资金管理
添加市场状态过滤器（如ATR或ADX），在震荡市中减少或暂停交易，避免虚假信号导致的连续亏损
设置合理的默认止损值而非0，并增加追踪止损功能以保护浮动利润
添加点差过滤，当点差超过阈值时不入场，保护交易免受高成本滑点影响
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account balance and risk percentage instead of fixed lots for proper money management
Add market regime filter (e.g., ATR or ADX) to reduce or pause trading in ranging markets, avoiding consecutive losses from false signals
Set a reasonable default StopLoss value instead of 0, and add trailing stop functionality to protect floating profits
Add spread filter to skip entries when spread exceeds a threshold, protecting trades from high-cost slippage

risk_points: 默认止损为0，用户可能在不设止损的情况下交易，面临无限亏损风险
固定手数无资金管理，大资金账户可能风险过低，小资金账户可能风险过高
在震荡市中缺乏过滤机制，可能产生频繁的开仓平仓导致手续费累积亏损
平仓使用3倍点差的滑点容忍度，在极端行情下可能无法及时平仓
risk_points_en: Default StopLoss of 0 means users may trade without stop loss, facing unlimited loss risk
Fixed lot sizing without money management — risk may be too low for large accounts or too high for small accounts
No filtering mechanism in ranging markets may cause frequent open/close cycles accumulating commission losses
Position closing uses 3x spread slippage tolerance, which may fail to close promptly in extreme market conditions
